# Scrawling Crawler (FDN), a 3/2 artifact creature (Phyrexian Construct) for {3}.
# "At the beginning of your upkeep, each player draws a card.
#  Whenever an opponent draws a card, that player loses 1 life."
# [0] Event: the compiler's "At the beginning of your upkeep" (frame B13-upkeep). "Each player
#     draws a card" is M20 Dragon Mage's verified "each player ... draws seven cards": an
#     EachPlayer(ANY) around DRAW with controller YOU, the rotated player (DRAW's controller role
#     takes one player, ATOM_DIVERGENCES D21 / B-108).
# [1] Event: "whenever an opponent draws a card" is CardDrawnEvent with actor CONTROLLER_IS
#     OPPONENT (the drawer, journalled on the row; M21 Lorescale Coatl's verified "whenever you
#     draw a card" is the YOU form). "That player" is the drawer: the referent 'event' Selector
#     names the drawn card (the event's subject), whose controller is the player who drew it
#     (R_ITSCONTROLLER: the referent of the triggering object, folded to its controller by
#     selectors.role_players). Every draw triggers it, the [0] draw included.
upkeep = TriggeredAbility(
    event=TurnPhaseEvent(
        phase=Phase.UPKEEP,
        actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.YOU),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=EachPlayer(
        ref=ControllerRef.ANY,
        effect=A(Verb.DRAW, {'amount': QConst(value=1), 'controller': ControllerRef.YOU}),
    ),
)
opponent_draws = TriggeredAbility(
    event=CardDrawnEvent(actor=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.CONTROLLER_IS, who=ControllerRef.OPPONENT)),
    condition=None,
    effect=A(Verb.LOSE_LIFE, {
        'amount': QConst(value=1),
        'controller': Selector(
            count=QConst(value=1),
            mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
            filter=FAnd(children=()),
            zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),),
            referent='event',
        ),
    }),
)
abilities = [upkeep, opponent_draws, *compiled]

clauses.clause: At the beginning of your upkeep, each player draws a card.
Whenever an opponent draws a card, that player loses 1 life.
